description: This Java source file defines the EntityCacheServices class which implements cache clearing functionalities for the Apache OFBiz Entity Engine. It includes methods for distributed cache clearing by value, primary key, dummy primary key, or condition, as well as a service method to clear all caches. The class interacts with dispatchers and entities to manage cache invalidation across distributed environments.

classes.name: EntityCacheServices
classes.description: A service class that provides distributed cache clearing functions for entity caching in OFBiz, including methods for clearing cache by different criteria and services for external invocation.

methods.name: setDelegator
methods.description: Initializes the delegator, dispatcher, and user login ID for cache operations.

methods.name: getAuthUserLogin
methods.description: Fetches the current authenticated user login entity from the database.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache lines based on a provided entity value.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineFlexible
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache lines based on a dummy primary key entity.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLineByCondition
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache lines that match a given condition on an entity.

methods.name: distributedClearCacheLine
methods.description: Asynchronously clears cache line based on a primary key.

methods.name: clearAllCaches
methods.description: Clears all entity caches, optionally distributing the cache clear across multiple nodes.

methods.name: clearCacheLine
methods.description: Performs cache line clearing for value, dummyPK, primaryKey, or condition based on service context.
